title: Georges de Selve, bishop of Lavaur, French ambassador at Venice, to Francis I, 14 Sept 1535 (BnF fr. 3091 f. 25, DECODE R3697) and 5 July 1536 (BnF fr. 3045 ff. 42-49, DECODE R4232); catalogue 178

steps.what: DECODE R3697/R4232 metadata (R3697 is fr. 3091 f. 25, not fr. 3045); Tomokiyo francis.htm gives the key table for Selve's cipher, no plaintext; BnF catalogue records cite no edition.
Gallica btv1b9060156p views 82-95 (fr. 3045) and btv1b9060253s views 27-28 (fr. 3091) at 2600-4400 px and native; cipher located on views 84, 85, 86, 88, 94 and on f. 25r-v.
Tomokiyo's table applied to fr. 3045 view 84 line 1: 'en tres grand danger combien que le nombre des assiegeans'.
One agent per page on R4232 (views 84, 85, 86/88/94): 1448 signs, extra homophones and the doubling nulls found; four glossed runs agree with the readings.
R4232 open spots re-read on native crops: v94 'ceste annee' (the unread verb), v88 'guerre'; name code valued from its gloss 'Rang..'.
Charriere, Negociations de la France dans le Levant I, pp. 265-320 read page by page on Gallica (no OCR): Selve letters of 18 June 1535, 22 Aug 1535, 24 Jan and 8 Feb 1536 printed, not these two.
R3697 first pass (f. 25r, f. 25v): about 70% / 50% of the unstruck cipher; new signs R = o, beta = v; soft film scan.
DECODE images of R3697 fetched with the project cookie: screenshots of the same film at lower resolution; no gain.
R3697 second pass with the extended table: f. 25r 92%, f. 25v lower block 97% of the unstruck cipher.

R3697 third pass: the decipherer's glosses used as cribs on the struck runs ('au marchant', 'ung sansacque cy prochain', 'amiablement pour la charge qu'il a de Vesprim'); struck runs from about 20% to 40%; 'soubz umbre de marchandise', 'fus adverty, meu de coniecture' read.
f. 25r r8-r9 read as '... Anthon[e] de Le[yve] de luy tenir le guet' (Antonio de Leyva, governor of Milan); not secured by the signs.
fr. 3019 f. 97r (Rodez and Selve, 16 Nov 1536) opened: three short glossed runs in the same cipher; no occurrence of the open r8 name.

outcome.method_basis: Tomokiyo's key table for Selve's cipher (cryptiana francis.htm, rebuilt from fr. 3045 ff. 42-49, naming fr. 3091 f. 25 as the same cipher) was applied and extended with further homophones, the doubling nulls and a glossed name code; the decipherer's glosses served as cribs on the struck runs.
outcome.notes: R4232 read (99.1% of non-null signs); R3697 read in part (79.1%; 94.9% of the cipher not under the decipherer's strike). Both together 2248 of 2481 non-null signs.

gaps.item: R3697 struck runs f. 25r A, B, C1-C3 and f. 25v T1-T3 (182 signs)
gaps.detail: the decipherer's ruling runs through every sign on the only (film) images; glosses give most of the plaintext; a colour image or the original would separate the lighter strike ink

gaps.item: R3697 f. 25r r16 end (5 signs), r9 blot (1)
gaps.detail: erased by the writer; solid blot

gaps.item: R3697 f. 25r r8-r9 'a pr[...] Anthon[e] de Le[...]' (17 signs)
gaps.detail: a blot and two cancellation diagonals cross four signs; the name is not secured; every candidate tried
isolated legible groups that fit no word; no sibling text to test them

gaps.item: R3697 f. 25v L5 final group (7 signs) and lone a before 'quand' (1)
gaps.detail: cancellation diagonal and blot; the cipher breaks off into struck clear text
blots and corrections under the decipherer's ruling; none affects the sense

outcome.fraction_read_source: R3697_signs.txt and R4232_signs.txt counted by stats.py: 2248 of 2481 non-null cipher signs read (letters, the glossed name code and one numeral); ? counted as unread

prior.where: Key table only: S. Tomokiyo, cryptiana francis.htm 'Selve's Cipher' (reconstructed from fr. 3045 ff. 42-49; names fr. 3091 f. 25 as the same cipher); no plaintext published. Contemporary partial decipherments on the leaves (glosses). DECODE 'Non-decrypted'. Charriere, Negociations dans le Levant I, prints other Selve letters of 1535-36, not these.

human: Project-level: set up Claude Code and posed the catalogue card (item 178). No target-specific intervention recorded.
